title: tc[r] is transitive
conclusion_ve: for every point x0, (for every point x1, (for every point x2, (if ((tc[r](x0, x1)) and (tc[r](x1, x2))), then (tc[r](x0, x2))))).
conclusion_fluent: for every point P and every point P2 and every point P3, if (both (P2 is reachable from P by one or more r steps) and (P3 is reachable from P2 by one or more r steps)) then (P3 is reachable from P by one or more r steps)
